tickets.title: feat(core,codegen): canonicalize trusted-binary resolver and extend generate.mjs to emit generated-shell, generated-risk-tier, and generated-trusted-binary
tickets.body:
## Context
Installed plugin hooks (`plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/`, `plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/`, `plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/`) execute without `node_modules` and currently hand-inline ~950 lines of `KEEP IN SYNC` copies of `@adlc/core` shell classifiers, risk-tier matchers, and trusted-binary resolvers.

## Changes Required
1. Create `packages/core/lib/trusted-binary.mjs` (`// GENERATED-TRUSTED-BINARY SOURCE.`) exporting `resolveTrustedBinary`, `ownershipRejection`, `ancestorDirs`, `candidateAncestors`, `binaryCandidates`, `candidateStats`, `candidateRejection`, and `untrustedBinaryReason`. Re-export from `packages/core/index.mjs` and declare in `packages/core/index.d.ts`, with unit tests in `packages/core/test/trusted-binary.test.mjs`.
2. Add `// GENERATED-SHELL SOURCE.` header to `packages/core/lib/shell.mjs`.
3. Add `'packages/core/lib/generated-glob-match.mjs'` to the `generated-glob-match` outputs list in `scripts/ticket-readers/generate.mjs` (`source: 'packages/core/lib/glob.mjs'`), and update `packages/core/lib/risk-tier.mjs` to start with `// GENERATED-RISK-TIER SOURCE.` and `import { globMatch } from './generated-glob-match.mjs'`.
4. Extend `ARTIFACTS` in `scripts/ticket-readers/generate.mjs` to emit `generated-shell.mjs`, `generated-risk-tier.mjs`, and `generated-trusted-binary.mjs`, run `node scripts/ticket-readers/generate.mjs`, add byte-for-byte parity checks in `scripts/test/ticket-reader-generation.test.mjs`, and run `npm run build:cursor-mcp`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `scripts/ticket-readers/generate.mjs --check` verifies byte-for-byte identity of `generated-shell.mjs`, `generated-risk-tier.mjs`, and `generated-trusted-binary.mjs` across `adlc-claude-code`, `adlc-codex`, and `adlc-copilot`.
- Verify: `node scripts/ticket-readers/generate.mjs --check && node --test packages/core/test/trusted-binary.test.mjs packages/core/test/core.test.mjs packages/core/test/risk-tier.test.mjs scripts/test/ticket-reader-generation.test.mjs scripts/test/ticket-store-boundary.test.mjs`

tickets.title: refactor(adlc-codex,adlc-copilot): replace hand-inlined shell classifiers and risk-tier matchers with generated hook modules
tickets.body:
## Context
`plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-rails-guard.mjs` and `plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/adlc-rails-guard.mjs` each inline ~250 lines of `packages/core/lib/shell.mjs`, and `plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-lifecycle.mjs` and `plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/adlc-lifecycle.mjs` each inline ~75 lines of `packages/core/lib/risk-tier.mjs`.

## Changes Required
1. In `plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-rails-guard.mjs` and `plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/adlc-rails-guard.mjs`, replace the hand-inlined shell classifier and path-extraction functions with imports (and re-exports) from `./generated-shell.mjs`.
2. In `plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-lifecycle.mjs` and `plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/adlc-lifecycle.mjs`, delete the hand-inlined `RISK_TIER_PATTERNS`, `matchRiskTier`, `classifyRiskTier`, `filesOverlapOrUnscoped`, and `decideAdversarialReviewNotice` definitions, import and re-export `{ RISK_TIER_PATTERNS, matchRiskTier, classifyRiskTier, decideAdversarialReviewNotice }` from `./generated-risk-tier.mjs`, and retain `export { globMatch } from './generated-glob-match.mjs';`.
3. Update `packages/core/test/shell.test.mjs` and `plugins/adlc-copilot/test/shell-drift.test.mjs` to assert that the hooks import `./generated-shell.mjs` and `./generated-risk-tier.mjs` and that the generated modules match `@adlc/core`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `adlc-codex` and `adlc-copilot` `adlc-rails-guard.mjs` and `adlc-lifecycle.mjs` import from `./generated-shell.mjs` and `./generated-risk-tier.mjs` (while retaining `export { globMatch } from './generated-glob-match.mjs'` in `adlc-lifecycle.mjs`) with zero hand-inlined classifier copies.
- Verify: `node --test packages/core/test/shell.test.mjs plugins/adlc-copilot/test/shell-drift.test.mjs plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/shell-quoting.test.mjs plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/review-notice.test.mjs plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/review-notice.test.mjs plugins/adlc-copilot/test/rails-guard-contract.test.mjs && node scripts/copilot-install-smoke.mjs`

tickets.title: refactor(adlc-claude-code,adlc-codex,adlc-copilot): replace hand-inlined trusted binary resolvers with generated-trusted-binary.mjs
tickets.body:
## Context
`plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/adlc-hook.mjs`, `plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-handoff-gate.mjs`, and `plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/adlc-build-gate.mjs` each hand-inline ~100 lines of `resolveTrustedBinary`, `ownershipRejection`, `ancestorDirs`, `candidateAncestors`, `binaryCandidates`, `candidateStats`, `candidateRejection`, and `untrustedBinaryReason`.

## Changes Required
1. In `plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/adlc-hook.mjs`, `plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-handoff-gate.mjs`, and `plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/adlc-build-gate.mjs`, replace the hand-inlined trusted-binary resolver helpers with imports and re-exports from `./generated-trusted-binary.mjs`.
2. Update `isolatedPluginDir(t)` in `plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/handoff-continuation-start.test.mjs`, `plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/handoff-secret-scrub.test.mjs`, `plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/handoff-deny.test.mjs`, and `plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/handoff-secret-scrub.test.mjs` to copy `generated-trusted-binary.mjs` into the isolated hook fixture directory.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `adlc-hook.mjs`, `adlc-handoff-gate.mjs`, and `adlc-build-gate.mjs` import and re-export `resolveTrustedBinary` and its ownership helpers from `./generated-trusted-binary.mjs` and pass all trusted-spawn and handoff tests.
- Verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/adlc-trusted-spawn.test.mjs plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/trusted-binary-root.test.mjs plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/trusted-binary-root.test.mjs plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/handoff-continuation-start.test.mjs plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/handoff-secret-scrub.test.mjs plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/handoff-deny.test.mjs plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/handoff-secret-scrub.test.mjs`
